tha-ap342:1.1: Ukkhittapadumiya.] Nagare Haṃsavatiyā āhosiṃ māliko tadā / ogahetvā padumasaraṃ satapatte ocinām' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap342:2.1: Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū / sahasatasahassehi santacittehi tādihi // //
tha-ap342:3.1: Khīṇāsavehi suddhehi chaḷābhiññāhi so saha / mama vuddhiṃ samannesaṃ āgacchi purisuttamo. // //
tha-ap342:4.1: Disvān' ahaṃ devadevan sayambhuṃ lokanāyakaṃ / vaṇṭe chetvā satapattam ukkhipim ambare tadā: // //
tha-ap342:5.1: ‘Yadi Buddho tuvaṃ vīra lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / sayaṃ gantvā satapattā matthake dhārayantu te.' // //
tha-ap342:6.1: Adhiṭṭhahi mahāvīro lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / Buddhassa ānubhāvena matthake dhārayiṃsu te. // //
tha-ap342:7.1: Tena kammena sukatena cetanāpaṇidhīhi ca / jahitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ Tāvatiṃsam agacch' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap342:8.1: Tattha me sukataṃ vyamhaṃ Satapattan ti vuccati / saṭṭhiyojanamubbiddhaṃ tiṃsayojanavitthataṃ. // //
tha-ap342:9.1: Sahassakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ / pañcasattatikkhattuñ ca cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ // //
tha-ap342:10.1: Padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ / anubhomi sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe sukatam attano // //
tha-ap342:11.1: Ten' eva ekapadumena anubhotvāna sampadā / Gotamassa bhagavato dhammaṃ sacchikarim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap342:12.1: Kilesā jhāpitā mayhaṃ bhavā sabbe samūhatā / nāgo va bandhanaṃ chetvā viharāmi anāsavo. // //
tha-ap342:13.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ekapadumass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap342:15.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ukkhittapadumiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap342:19.1: Gandhodaka-Pūjanī ca Punnāga-Ekadussikā Phusito ca Pabhaṅkāro Kuṭido Uttarīyako.
tha-ap342:20.1: Savanī Ekapadumī gāthāyo tattha piṇḍitā ekaṃ gāthāsatañ c' eva catu*tālīsa*meva ca.
